name: DatoCMS
description: Official DatoCMS agent skills for content modeling, reading and writing content, CLI workflows, frontend integrations, and plugin development.

skills.name: content-modeling
skills.description: Schema-design decisions: model vs block, references vs embedded blocks, taxonomies, field shapes, validators, and editor appearances.

skills.name: reading-content
skills.description: GraphQL queries against the Content Delivery API: filters, pagination, localization, modular content, Structured Text, responsive images, and SEO metadata.

skills.name: writing-content
skills.description: Programmatic Content Management API scripts: record CRUD, bulk imports/exports, asset uploads, environment forks and promotions, webhooks, roles, and tokens.

skills.name: cli-workflows
skills.description: CLI-driven migrations, schema-type generation, typed CMA scripts, environment operations, CI/CD pipelines, and WordPress/Contentful imports.

skills.name: frontend-integrations
skills.description: Draft mode, Web Previews, Visual Editing, and Content Link overlays across Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, and Astro.

skills.name: one-shot-setup
skills.description: Bootstraps multi-step flows like setting up draft mode and visual editing, or wiring up migrations.

skills.name: plugin-development
skills.description: Create a brand-new DatoCMS plugin from scratch with the Vite/React structure.
